steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Here's the pizza you ordered.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Grazie.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Is someone sitting here?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Great, glad to join you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I said the seat's taken.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You should go and continue your famiglia's work. Don't bother a commoner like me.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm not blaming you, Leon.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I don't blame Bernardo either.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If there's anyone to blame, it would have to be me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It's my fault I was born into this country and still cling to these fantasies in my heart. I have no reason to blame either of you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm not trying to reason with you at a time like this.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know full well that comforting words mean nothing right now.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Even though I'm a victim just like you, it's only natural that you see me as a perpetrator.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: All I can tell you is... I still haven't given up.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: There are too many things going on in the city these days. Do keep an eye out, and stay safe. If you run into any problems, give me a call.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Segretario Rubio.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Are you free right now, Your Honor?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Folks on the street seem mighty jumpy.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What happened yesterday was a pretty big deal.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You really gonna go talk to that director?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes. There are some things I need to set straight with him, no matter what.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It'll be fine. Keep doing what you need to do, Croissant.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll be there. Don't worry.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: In that case, I'll be Croissant's bodyguard for the day!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thanks. I appreciate it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: If things go south, you give us a holler.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Will do.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Croissant, you're thinking about the whole business with Texas again, aren't you?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Readin' me like a book, huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You can say that again.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm the same, after all.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I know what Sora is thinking. If Texas really wants to stay, she's going to respect her opinion.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And I agree with that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I still want my sister to meet my friends.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: At least, if there's any way to get Texas out of Siracusa safely, you'd want to find it too, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yeah... Reckon I can't hide anything from you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Probably couldn't hide it from those two either.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Just like we can understand what Sora is thinking, they understand what we're thinking.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But this is still Siracusa... and Texas is tanglin' with some of the biggest shots in the country. I got no clue what I'm even s'posta do.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh? I thought you would've already figured it out.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uhh... Speaking of big shots in the country, didn't we meet one of them yesterday?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Welcome, Signorina Sora. Signorina Cellinia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Why are you dragging Sora and the others into this?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Sora's resume coming across my desk was honestly a coincidence.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Of course, it could also be something of an inevitability.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: After all, Compagnia dell'alba is a pretty well-known troupe in Siracusa.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But what most fans don't know is that the troupe's director is actually the don of Famiglia Bellone. That, of course, is a secret.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: After all, I have handed the famiglia's business in this city to my son, and I'm no backseat driver.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Signorina Cellinia, Signorina Sora, I've been directing this troupe for six years.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I hope the two of you can at least believe that my pursuit and love of the arts has nothing to do with my business.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I too would like to see Signorina Sora shine dazzling-bright onstage, if I could, then let the two of you finish your heartwarming reunion.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But, you don't particularly care if she does get dragged in, do you?

spans.text: But, you don't particularly care if she

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Drop the pretense, Bernardo.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No matter how you try to sugarcoat it, even if meeting Sora was just a coincidence, how could I expect you to care about her safety?

spans.text: No matter how you try to sugarcoat it, even if meeting Sora
just a coincidence, how could I expect you to care about her safety?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Enough jokes.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Lovely, Cellinia. This is the first time I've seen you angry since you got back to Siracusa.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Director, there's something I need to know.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Is the agreement between the two of us still valid?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You're talking about—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That even if I found Texas, I'd stay with the troupe and continue performing.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And here I thought you came to terminate our contract.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What I can do is totally insignificant in the face of the conflict between families.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It'll be too hard for Texas to protect us in all that chaos.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And I trust that you are a man of your word, at least.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So, to cut to the chase, I'm willing to stay here and be your hostage.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Your bravery never ceases to impress me, signorina.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But there's no need to be nervous.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I didn't call you here to castigate you. In fact, what happened at the theater was meant to be a healthy exchange of pleasantries with the Rossatis.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: What you've accomplished has already surpassed my wildest dreams.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And so, I'd like to inform you—

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: That the contract between us is terminated.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You're free to go.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: From now on, Cellinia is no longer under Famiglia Bellone's protection.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Is this bargaining chip enough to satisfy you, my friend?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Satisfy me?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You think I'd forget who brought her back in the first place?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: All I want to know is, what was the point of this? From the very beginning?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You should thank my son.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: He was the one who convinced me you were someone to cooperate with.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Leon? Hah, I see.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I've always been optimistic about Famiglia Rossati's development.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Cellinia was just the one who built the foundation for our cooperation today.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: In other words, even if Leontuzzo didn't come to me, you would have.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Like father, like son. Touching.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Heh. I just hope my son can learn a thing or two from your drive.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Listen, Bernardo, other people might fall for your tricks.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But I won't.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Of course, Wallach. I did these things only to show you who really stands in your way.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Oh? Is my biggest obstacle not sitting right in front of me?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: If you think you can get me to betray my donna, keep dreaming.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Perish the thought. No. This is a reminder.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Deep down, you know the truth.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Cellinia's visit has greatly affected Giovanna.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Everyone in Siracusa respects Salvadore, but respect isn't blind obedience.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Salvadore's era ended seven years ago. In this day and age, are you still willing to serve Giovanna to protect his legacy?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You could've soared higher and farther.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The Donna works for the greater good.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Is the greater good she wants the same one you want?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Famiglia Rossati used to dominate Columbia, standing on equal footing with the Texases.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Coming back here to Siracusa, they're pushed around by the other eleven famiglie.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Shouldn't your Rossatis rise above the other famiglie, and drag Signora Sicilia down from Grey Hall?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Stop talking like you know me, old man.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I don't know you, but I know people like you, and I know the look in your eye.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Not a single man alive could ever get comfortable with the stagnant cesspool that Siracusa has become.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You understood that when you saw Cellinia walk out of that room alive, didn't you?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Even if that's true, even if what you say is right.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: That's something for our famiglia to figure out.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Aren't old-fashioned famiglie like yours the most reluctant to get their hands dirty?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Are you telling me this is what Siracusan dignity means?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Wrong again, Wallach.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I invited you here to share an opportunity with you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: An opportunity to overthrow the existing order in Siracusa, and establish a new one.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Why the Rossatis?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Sixty years ago, Signora Sicilia brought back two things from Laterano: 'Guns, and order.'

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Today, people think a unified decision of the Dodici Famiglie created Grey Hall.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But they forget how Signora Sicilia got the Dodici to sit down together.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Absolute power.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Alberto is too prudent, too analytical. He's been cautious his whole life.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And prudence isn't what I need to take on Signora Sicilia. What I want...

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Is a friend who's also looking to overthrow the existing order.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Think about it carefully, Wallach.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: This is the best opportunity you're going to get.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Is the Donna here?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Over in that room.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Go and tell her that I'm going to deal with Cellinia by abducting her friends.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Are we seriously going to do that?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: What you should be asking instead is—

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Is this really what you want the Rossatis to be?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You sure the guy we met yesterday was all that wonderful?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah, I've got a hunch!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Why would such a heavy hitter be hangin' around this town though?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I think it makes sense. If I were in his position, I'd do the same thing!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hearin' it from you does make it more convincing, somehow.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But how d'ya know he's at the courthouse?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hmm... Oh, there you are.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, do you remember the last thing he said? It gave me the impression he'd normally be in court, not at church.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Right, sir?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm thinkin'... we should leave him be...

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Hrmm... Huh?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Oh, it's you kids.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hello there!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We came to ask you a few questions.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Hahaha! Good, good. Take a seat. It's never a bad day to talk to the youths.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We got a friend who's all mixed up in a contract with of them families. They got her doin' all kinds of things for 'em.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We've been noodlin' on whether or not there might be a way out for her?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Your friend's surname is Texas, isn't it?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I've heard that Bernardo is a man of his word.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: As a don, he must never break his promises.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But even us foreigners can tell all this hubbub is the Bellone family tryin' to rile up Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We... ain't about to go stickin' our heads in all this complicated business. And to be honest, it don't got much to do with us, neither.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But we don't want Texas gettin' any payback from Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Back then, Sicilia's fury towards Giuseppe for what he had done was just as great as her admiration of Salvadore.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Because it was the most direct challenge to the order she had established.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Sicilia accepts all comers within this order, but she will not allow anyone to upend the entire order.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So what you're sayin' is... There ain't no loopholes in this order, izzat it?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I used to think that, my child.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But there are no absolutes, when it comes to orders established by man.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Just as why me meeting you has nothing to do with Cellinia.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: It was just because I happened to meet a fellow Sankta here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Heehee~

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Before Sicilia, the land of Siracusa was not without order.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: The only difference is the order that the families believed in came from themselves, and as no two famiglie could ever share the same order, they could only fight.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Sicilia's actions did not completely break this order.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Instead, it unified the orders among different families into a single, universal standard.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: All the families were united into one.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: And thus, Siracusa became Siracusa.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Now tell me, do you know what this means?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yer sayin'... Siracusa, before n' after Signora Sicilia... never actually changed?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Clever girl.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: The problems that existed in Siracusa in the past still exist today. I, no, we, are all aware of this fact.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But all these problems can be resolved by seeing Sicilia's fold.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Meetin' Signora Sicilia... that's a tall order.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: That is one thing I will not help you with.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But, for her, there might be a way.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: However—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: However?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: The price may be too high to pay.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Donna?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: You've been staring at that necklace in your hand since last night.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: This is a symbol of trust given to me by Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: For picking up the pieces of Famiglia Texas, and leading the Columbian famiglie back to Siracusa.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Oh, it must be pretty valuable.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Are you gonna use it to help, somehow?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I'm still on the fence.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You said Wallach plans to attack Cellinia's friends?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Yes. They stepped out a while ago, but when they get back, we'll have an ambush in place.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: To buy some chocolate.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Tsk, tsk. Turns out, your guess was right on the money.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Rossati associates have already started to infiltrate the block.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: When those ladies from Penguin Logistics get back, I'm afraid they're gonna die a gruesome death.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But, lemme ask you a question, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Lay it on me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I figured the Rossatis would try to rub out Texas.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But you're still a Saluzzo. You really need to send Gambino after that Sankta while you stay here and house-sit for 'em?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I never knew you were to give so much for the sake of friendship.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Am I that type?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Definitely not.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Which is why I want to know, what the hell are you waitin' for?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You plowed that truck right into the courtroom, turned yourself in, and cleared her name in the process. Then you went on and forced the Saluzzos and Bellones together.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I got no clue why the two famiglie actually started working together. But there's gotta be another reason for it, right? You know that by helping the Bellones, you're also helpin' her.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And that's before we talk about how you gave her a hand in yesterday's assassination.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You say you wanna prove to her that Siracusa's a swamp you can't escape.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But it looks to me like you're tryin' to help her escape.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If I need to kill a few of her loved ones, or do something to piss her off, just to prove my point...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: All that would show is how paranoid I am. Wouldn't get anywhere with that.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If it's real, if it's a fact, then it'll happen, even if I just stood by and watched.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But actually, even that isn't good enough.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I can't just get out of her way, I have to give her enough help so that in the end, she has to finally admit—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That all her struggling was for nothing.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And doing it like that will bring you some satisfaction?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Dunno. All I do know is there's no other way.

spans.text: know is there's no other way.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: So basically, you don't know what to do either.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Yep. And I never said I did.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And you, Capone, you should be more like Gambino and realize that you'll never get the answer you want from me about the two of you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You already knew, huh.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: He wants to stage his comeback by joining up with the Bellones, but what about you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're still standing here. Do you seriously think you're my vassal?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or, are you hoping there's enough room for you on my path?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Give up that hope, or I'll kill you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There's only room for one.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What about Texas?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Texas... might just be the path itself.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hah.
Capone stays silent for a minute before turning and leaving.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Ahh, what a pleasant surprise.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I haven't been here before... but it looks like I'm in the right place.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: So this is Penguin Logistics's little stronghold.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Miss Caterina.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Sora... Oh, right, I gave you my number before.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Would it be better if I called you Miss Giovanna?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Caterina will do just fine.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I like the name.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Do all Siracusan mobsters like to work in the performing arts?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Why not? We can't be fighting and killing each other all the time.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Are you all together right now?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Miss Caterina?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Never mind.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Sora, would you mind telling me more about your Penguin Logistics?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: For example, how it came to be, and how Cellinia joined.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm not too clear on the details myself. After all, Penguin Logistics was already a thing by the time Texas saved me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The boss mentioned a few times how he set up Penguin Logistics after he met Texas.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But when it comes to stuff that happened after I joined, I could talk for days about that.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We've been living together for years.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: *sigh*... I'd really love to chat with you more, if we get the chance.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: There's a lot I'd like to tell you about Cellinia.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I also want to hear more from you about her life in Lungmen.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If you ever get a chance to drop by Lungmen, we'd be glad to show you around.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You're not worried about my business?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What matters is you were once Texas's best friend.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Cellinia truly is blessed to have met a woman as kind as you in Lungmen.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If you ask me, she's blessed to have a friend like you in Siracusa who's always thinking of her.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Oh right, Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I had a flash of inspiration just now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I'm always thinking about how I want the grand finale to play out.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: In my story, I thought she should meet her end just like a Siracusan would.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Surrounded, in a narrow alley, incinerated by a car bomb, so on, so forth.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: These little excerpts from reality are so overused that they've turned into their own tropes.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I want to escape the tropes, and in this story, have her become the least Siracusan Siracusan.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I've been trying to find a 'Siracusan' archetype, but haven't been able to define it.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: That's the source of my writer's block.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But right now, it's starting to come to me.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: There are no Siracusans.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Cellinia Texas finally disappeared in the conflagration, and nobody knew what became of her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Miss Caterina, are you...?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I'll be back later. I have some presents for you girls.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Wallach, if memory serves me right, you're trying to kidnap Cellinia's friends?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: They're not even back yet, and you've gathered a whole mob?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I would have, if you didn't show up.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'm extremely disappointed, Donna. No, Giovanna.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Were you that impatient with me?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: It's not a question of patience. It's just, why should we wait?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Why should we have to sit here and wait for the blessing of some antique?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: We followed you to this country, waiting to become masters of this land.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And now, we have an opportunity.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Are you so sure? You're certain victory is within your grasp?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Nope. I'm not even certain I can deal with that antique...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But I know Bellone really wants to bring us into a new age.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And I've got a hankering to make a big bet.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: How many are willing to follow you?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Seventy percent.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: What about the rest?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'll convince them.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Or, you could do it for me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: If you decide to change your mind, Giovanna, you're still our boss.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Looks like I brought up some good soldiers after all.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Sorry, Wallach.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Is Texas more important to you than Famiglia Rossati?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I just... don't think this is how things should play out.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The way I see it, some things can only play out like this.
